final:
title_of(html: str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex title_of("<html><head><title>My Title</title></head></html>") == "My Title"
  ex title_of("no title here") == ""
  let parts = html.split("<title>")
  let rest = parts.get(1) else return ""
  let end_parts = rest.split("</title>")
  let after = end_parts.get(1) else return ""
  copy end_parts[0]

test_title_of() =
  assert title_of("<html><head><title>My Title</title></head></html>") == "My Title"
  assert title_of("no title here") == ""
  assert title_of("<title>no closing tag") == ""
  assert title_of("<title></title>") == ""
